下面是一个本地条件表单：关闭开关会隐藏明细字段，但保留其值，且隐藏时不参与必填校验；点击按钮只会生成可编辑草稿，不会发送。

```kelivo-ui
ui 1 catalog "kelivo.native/1"
root = Column(children=[form,ask], gap="medium")
$on: boolean = false
$name: string = ""
$detail: string = "保留内容"
form = Form(children=[toggle,nameField,detailField], title="邮寄地址")
toggle = Switch(label="启用明细地址", bind=$on)
nameField = TextField(label="收件人姓名", bind=$name, required=true, placeholder="请输入姓名", maxLength=200)
detailField = TextField(label="详细地址", bind=$detail, required=true, visible=$on, placeholder="请输入详细地址", maxLength=500)
ask = Button(label="准备表单检查草稿", form=form, action=Ask(text="请检查此邮寄地址表单的可编辑草稿（不会自动发送）。", context={"name":$name,"enabled":$on,"detail":$detail}))
```
